tagline: Il tuo piano di studio. Sempre al passo con te.
emotional_archetype: Organic & Scholarly Precision (Notion x Linear x Duolingo Polish)
design_principles: Mobile-First & Tactile Responsiveness: Designed with thumb zones in mind, crisp tactile feedback, smooth sheet transitions, and responsive grid layouts for desktop.
Calm Cognitive Clarity: Pure light warm canvas (#FAFA3 / #F8FAFC) with elevated white card surfaces (#FFFFFF), structured borders, and intentional accent color signals.
Action-Oriented Academic Direction: High visibility countdowns, exam urgency badges, progress meters, and single-tap adaptive replanning ('Sono rimasto indietro').
Italian University Native Context: First-class handling of CFU, Appelli, Sessioni d'esame (Invernale, Estiva, Autunnale), Voto target (18-30L), and Teoria vs Esercizi vs Ripasso study blocks.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on every button, input, card, menu item, progress bar, and modal

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user-facing text is strictly in Italian.
Do NOT build a dark generic dashboard. Implement the Warm Light Minimal aesthetic ('Chiaro e minimale').
Ensure responsiveness: Bottom navigation on mobile devices (<768px), elegant sidebar on desktop (>=768px).
Include full data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Use Framer Motion for smooth tab transitions, modal entrances, and checkbox completions.
Implement mock persistence with localStorage so user exam inputs, time block completions, and AI chat messages persist across page reloads.
